scheme.title: Access Method
scheme.description: How an access point is used: download a file, visit a page, call a service, or ask for the data.

concepts.label: Download
concepts.description: A direct link to a file or a bundle of files.

concepts.label: Landing page
concepts.description: A page at the source that describes the data and links to it.

concepts.label: Service
concepts.description: An API or map service (WMS/WFS, OGC API, STAC API, Earth Engine, REST).

concepts.label: Request
concepts.description: The data is obtained by asking; see access_note.
